name: Shisper / Mochowar ice-dammed lake
coord_source: The ice-dammed lake's basin at the Muchuhar–Shisper confluence: Sentinel-2 water centroids 74.5656 E, 36.3593 N (0.32 km², 25 May 2020) and 74.5681 E, 36.3577 N (0.20 km², 5 Apr 2022); HMAGLOFDB v1.3.0 (CC0) lake point 74.572267 E, 36.35594 N, events GF 499–516
downstream: Hassanabad village and the Karakoram Highway bridge
downstream_source: Dawn, 7 May 2022, https://www.dawn.com/news/1688466 (the Hassanabad bridge on the Karakoram Highway destroyed); Radio Pakistan, 9 May 2022, https://radio.gov.pk/09-05-2022/all-resources-to-be-utilized-for-rehabilitation-of-shishper-glacier-affectees-cm-gb
lake_state_source: no water in the basin in Sentinel-2, 17 Aug 2026 (clearest scene of 1 Jul–30 Sep 2026); the lake last held water in spring 2022 and burst on 7 May 2022
elevation_source: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (Copernicus_DSM_COG_10_N36_00_E074_00_DEM, Earth Search), 10th percentile within 1 km of the lake point

name: Khurdopin ice-dammed lake
coord_source: HMAGLOFDB v1.3.0 (Zenodo 18257243, CC0) lake point, the dataset of Shrestha et al. 2023, ESSD 15:3941
lake_state_source: the basin against the Khurdopin glacier tongue is a dry sediment flat in Sentinel-2, 17 Aug 2026 (clearest scene of 1 Jul–30 Sep 2026); the lake last formed in 2017–2021 (HMAGLOFDB events 2017, 2018 and 2021)
forming_share_source: the Shimshal River runs through the 1 km circle: on all 14 clear Sentinel-2 scenes of 15 Jun–30 Sep 2026 the empty zone read 7.8–13.3% water (0.24–0.42 km2), so only water above 16% (about 0.08 km2 more than the river's highest) says a lake may be forming; a lake as small as the 2017 one (0.043 km2) would not show
limits: The Sentinel-2 check for a lake forming here cannot see a lake smaller than about 0.08 km²: the Shimshal River fills 8–13% of the 1 km circle in summer.
elevation_source: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (Copernicus_DSM_COG_10_N36_00_E075_00_DEM, Earth Search), 10th percentile within 1 km of the lake point

name: Karambar glacier terminus pond (historic ice-dam site)
coord_source: HMAGLOFDB v1.3.0 (CC0), lake GL074079E36622N; a terminus pond of about 0.05–0.08 km² sits at this point in Sentinel-2, Jul–Sep 2026
elevation_source: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (Copernicus_DSM_COG_10_N36_00_E074_00_DEM, Earth Search), 10th percentile within 1 km of the lake point

name: Rogheli glacier supraglacial pond (Chitral)
coord_source: Centre of the supraglacial pond in Sentinel-2 on 28 Jun 2019 (0.031 km2) and 27 Jun 2020 (0.036 km2), 100 m from the HMAGLOFDB v1.3.0 (CC0) lake point 71.968 E, 35.853 N of the Golain GLOFs of 7 Jul 2019 and 13 Jul 2020 (events GF 498 and 504)
lake_state_source: no water in Sentinel-2 on any clear scene of 23 Jun–11 Sep 2026; a supraglacial pond of about 0.03 km2 formed here in late June 2019 and 2020 and drained in the 7 Jul 2019 and 13 Jul 2020 GLOFs (HMAGLOFDB GF 498, 504)
forming_share_source: in the 150 m circle the empty zone read 0–5.4% water on the 13 clear Sentinel-2 scenes of 15 Jun–30 Sep 2026 (wet snow and single pixels), while the pond filled 40% on 28 Jun 2019, 43% on 27 Jun 2020 and 17% on 2 Jul 2020 as it drained
elevation_source: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (Copernicus_DSM_COG_10_N35_00_E071_00_DEM, Earth Search), 10th percentile within 1 km of the lake point

name: Shazore moraine-dammed lake (KP)
coord_source: On the 2026 remnant lake, 150 m from its shore in Sentinel-2 (30 Aug and 11 Sep 2026); 230 m from the HMAGLOFDB v1.3.0 (CC0) lake point 72.175989 E, 35.780972 N of the 30 Aug 2024 GLOF (event GF 734), which now lies on the exposed lake bed
limits: The lake partly drained in the GLOF of 30 Aug 2024 (HMAGLOFDB GF 734). The outline is the 2026 remnant lake from Sentinel-2 (0.117 km²), not the pre-2024 lake (0.15 km², OpenStreetMap way 349316277).
elevation_source: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (Copernicus_DSM_COG_10_N35_00_E072_00_DEM, Earth Search), 10th percentile within 1 km of the lake point
